repos.name: Raja0sama/vibex
repos.description: Architecture diagrams and checkable docs from your codebase — ERD, C4, API and lifecycle — generated from Prisma, OpenAPI or GraphQL. One HTML file, no server.
repos.one_liner: A zero-server documentation tool that generates architecture diagrams and lifecycle docs directly from your codebase.
bullets: Parses Prisma schemas, OpenAPI specs, and GraphQL definitions to visualize system architecture.
Outputs a single, portable HTML file containing ERDs, C4 models, and API documentation.
Eliminates the need for external documentation servers or complex infrastructure.
Ideal for devtools workflows requiring automated, up-to-date system visualization.
repos.img_alt: vibeX: four diagrams and a checkable document, from one command

Designed as a modular agent skill for integration into automated content creation pipelines.
Useful for fintech/tech media teams needing to summarize video-based financial news or tutorials.
